security.validation_logic_comparison: v2 adds exactly one check v1 lacks: is_valid_hash_format ('R-' + 128 hex). Everything else — recompute, difficulty on the hex part, previous_hash link, tx validation — is identical. The extra check can only reject, never accept something v1 would reject: v2 is strictly stricter than v1 on block hashes.
